items.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023
items.q: The interviewee mentions Monk only in the context of narrating a story about Pepper Adams and John Wilson ('...critical review that John Wilson had written about his performance with Monk...'). The interviewee does not describe a personal relationship with Monk.

ctx.x: Thank you, thank you. Boy that’s funny. I recognized the intent of the lyric I just couldn’t place it. That’s pretty obscure, Monk, I’m sorry but —
Well it’s like people like Bucky Pizzarelli for instance, you’ll find a fact about him. For instance that he played on Ben E. King’s “Stand By Me” and you’ll tell him that and he’ll go, “I did?”
